remarks: STUNNING NEW CONSTRUCTION contemporary residence in San Clemente designed with modern coastal luxury in mind scheduled to complete construction in September. Soaring 10-foot ceilings and an open-concept floor plan create an effortless flow between the kitchen, dining, and living areas, all showcasing beautiful ocean views. A dramatic oversized pivot entry door sets the tone for the home’s elevated design, while seven skylights fill the interiors with natural light. Thoughtful architectural details include smooth stucco, smooth drywall, hardwood soffit accents, clean modern lines, and high-end finishes throughout.
